xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4905: Add a Fly machine error says remote.enabled must be set 'in the Overdeck config' but only config.toml works

plan.title: Add a Fly machine error says remote.enabled must be set 'in the Overdeck config' but only config.toml works
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Add a Fly machine refusal says remote.enabled must be set 'in the Overdeck config'. config.yaml has a remote: section, so operators set it there, but remote.enabled is read only from ~/.overdeck/config.toml [remote]. pan admin config set remote.enabled true also writes config.yaml and silently does nothing. The dialog only fails after the Add click, and sibling messages name no file or a dead verb (pan remote setup).
narratives.Proposal: Keep config.toml as the only home of remote.enabled. Add src/lib/remote-enabled.ts with a shared hint ('add `enabled = true` under `[remote]` in ~/.overdeck/config.toml'), a config.yaml probe, and a targeted atomic config.toml writer. Use the hint in the Fly refusal (plus a note when config.yaml sets remote.enabled) ; refuse pan admin config set remote.enabled; expose self.remoteEnabled on GET /api/machines; show a remote-off notice and a Turn on remote button (POST /api/machines/fly/enable-remote) in the dialog; document it.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Making config.yaml accept or override remote.enabled
- A new pan admin remote enable CLI verb
- A remote toggle in Settings → Remote (RemoteSection.tsx)
- Turning remote off from the dashboard
- Pre-click remote state in the new-conversation dialog's Fly (new VM) choice
- Changing pan admin remote setup behaviour or what it writes
- Fly token (no-fly-token) UX changes
- Touching src/lib/settings-api.ts, src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts or src/lib/config-yaml/schema.ts, or raising any file-size allowlist cap
- Rewording the other remote-not-enabled messages (start.ts, workspace-migrate.ts, remote/*.ts, spawn-issue.ts, routes/remote.ts, remote-workspace.ts); that is follow-up PAN-4908

autoDecisions.summary: config.toml stays the only home of remote.enabled; config.yaml is not taught to accept it
autoDecisions.rationale: Docs, pan admin remote setup and doctor-fly already treat config.toml as the home; a second home for a spend gate recreates the two-homes confusion this issue reports; settings-api.ts and routes/settings.ts have 5 and 0 lines of file-size headroom.

autoDecisions.summary: Ship Turn on remote as a targeted atomic edit of only [remote] enabled in config.toml
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the dialog should ideally offer it; saveConfig is sync and rewrites the whole file, and pan admin remote setup also flips default_location, so neither is reused.

autoDecisions.summary: Pre-click state comes from optional MachinesResponse.self.remoteEnabled/remoteConfigFile on GET /api/machines
autoDecisions.rationale: The panel already polls that query and the dialog shares the cache key; no new read route or no-loss row is needed, and optional fields keep older peers decoding.

autoDecisions.summary: The dialog stays openable when remote is off, shows a notice and disables Add; the panel button reads 'Add a Fly machine (remote off)'
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's 'say up front that remote is off' while keeping the Turn on remote action one click away.

autoDecisions.summary: pan admin config set remote.enabled refuses with exit 1 and prints the hint
autoDecisions.rationale: A successful-looking no-op write to config.yaml is the same trap the issue reports.

autoDecisions.summary: No new CLI verb for enabling remote
autoDecisions.rationale: The CLI message names the exact file and line, which is what the issue asks; a new verb also needs a wrapper skill.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the eight sibling remote-not-enabled messages into follow-up PAN-4908
autoDecisions.rationale: They are a separate bug (dead verb, no file named), touch 10 files nothing else here touches, and kept this plan over the 25-file finalize surface limit.

metadata.sizeJustification: 21 files is under the file limit; the subsystem count exceeds 6 only because each top-level doc file (configuration/linked-machines.mdx, docs/fly-provider.md, docs/ANYWHERE-ARCHITECTURE.md) counts as its own subsystem. The code is one inseparable feature for one dialog: the refusal text, the pre-click state on GET /api/machines, and the Turn on remote door share the new src/lib/remote-enabled.ts helper and ship together; the separable part (sibling messages) is already split to PAN-4908.

items.title: Create remote-enabled helper module with hint and yaml probe

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-1. Create src/lib/remote-enabled.ts exporting displayPath(path), remoteEnabledHint(path = CONFIG_FILE) and async configYamlSetsRemoteEnabled(path = getGlobalConfigPath()) exactly as the PRD snippet shows; async fs only. Add src/lib/__tests__/remote-enabled.test.ts with temp-dir fixtures.

items.title: Given path /x/config.toml, remoteEnabledHint returns exactly: add `enabled = true` under `[remote]` in /x/config.toml
Given a path under the home directory, displayPath returns it with the home prefix replaced by ~
Given a config.yaml containing remote.enabled: true, configYamlSetsRemoteEnabled returns true; given only remote.resiliency_tier, a missing file, or unparseable YAML it returns false
Add enableRemoteInConfigToml targeted config.toml writer

expected_outputs: remote-enabled.test.ts passes including the writer cases

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-2. Add RemoteEnableError and enableRemoteInConfigToml(path = CONFIG_FILE) to src/lib/remote-enabled.ts following the 7-step algorithm in the PRD (parse, idempotent early return, replace-or-insert the enabled line in the [remote] table or append a [remote] table, re-parse and require remote.enabled === true, atomic write via writeFileAtomic from src/lib/model-presets/state.ts with mode 0o644). Never call saveConfig. Extend the test file.

items.title: Given [remote] with enabled = false and comment lines elsewhere, the writer replaces only the enabled line and preserves every other line byte-for-byte
Given a config.toml whose remote.enabled is already true, the writer returns changed: false and leaves the file text unchanged
Given a missing config.toml, the writer creates a file that parses with remote.enabled === true
Given an inline remote = { enabled = false } table or unparseable TOML, the writer rejects with RemoteEnableError and leaves the file unchanged
Name config.toml and the yaml trap in the remote-disabled Fly refusal

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-3. In src/dashboard/server/services/fly-machine-service.ts add yamlSetsRemoteEnabled to FlyMachineServiceDeps and defaultDeps, and replace the line-177 message with the PRD's after-snippet. Update fly-machine-service.test.ts fakes and add two message tests; update the fixture text in AddFlyMachineDialog.test.tsx lines 72 and 76.

items.title: Given remote.enabled is not true, addFlyMachine rejects with code remote-disabled and a message containing `enabled = true`, `[remote]` and config.toml
Given config.yaml sets remote.enabled, the remote-disabled message also contains 'config.yaml sets remote.enabled, but that file does not hold this setting'
Given remote is off, addFlyMachine still rejects before provision is called (the existing it.each row keeps passing)
Report remoteEnabled and remoteConfigFile on GET /api/machines

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-6. Add optional remoteEnabled (Boolean) and remoteConfigFile (String) to MachinesResponse.self in packages/contracts/src/machines.ts; fill them in buildMachinesResponse() in src/dashboard/server/routes/machines.ts from async loadConfig() and displayPath(CONFIG_FILE). Add a route test.

Given config.toml with [remote] enabled = true, GET /api/machines returns self.remoteEnabled true
GET /api/machines returns self.remoteConfigFile ending in config.toml, and a MachinesResponse without either field still decodes
Add POST /api/machines/fly/enable-remote

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-7. Add machinesFlyEnableRemoteRouteLayer in src/dashboard/server/routes/machines-fly.ts (channel 403, rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest, enableRemoteInConfigToml, 200/409/500 bodies, activity entry when changed), register it in src/dashboard/server/server.ts next to machinesFlyRouteLayer, add the no-loss-matrix row, and add route tests.

items.title: Given remote off, POST /api/machines/fly/enable-remote returns 200 { ok: true, changed: true } and config.toml then parses with remote.enabled true
Given a request through a secure channel, the route returns 403 and writes nothing
Given the writer throws RemoteEnableError, the route returns 409 { error: 'remote-enable-failed', message }
The no-loss matrix test accepts the new route because its row exists
Show remote-off notice in the Add a Fly machine dialog before the click

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-8. In AddFlyMachineDialog.tsx query MACHINES_QUERY_KEY via loadMachines, render the data-testid=fly-remote-off notice and disable Add when self.remoteEnabled === false, rewrite the line-105 helper text and module header; in MachinesPanel.tsx show 'Add a Fly machine (remote off)' while off. Follow the pan-style-guide skill. Add tests. Browser verification (test/UAT) runs in an isolated Playwright profile against a dashboard started with a throwaway OVERDECK_HOME, never the operator's :3011 dashboard, because Turn on remote writes the real config.toml.

items.title: Given GET /api/machines returns self.remoteEnabled false, the dialog renders data-testid=fly-remote-off naming config.toml and the Add button is disabled before any click
Given self.remoteEnabled true or absent, the dialog renders no remote-off notice and Add is enabled
Given self.remoteEnabled false, the Machines panel button text reads 'Add a Fly machine (remote off)'
Add Turn on remote button to the Add a Fly machine dialog

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-9. Add enableRemote() to machinesApi.ts; render a Turn on remote button inside the remote-off notice and whenever a POST /api/machines/fly returns error remote-disabled; on success toast, clear the error and invalidate MACHINES_QUERY_KEY; on failure show body.message in the role=alert element. Add tests. Browser verification (test/UAT) runs in an isolated Playwright profile against a dashboard started with a throwaway OVERDECK_HOME, never the operator's :3011 dashboard, because Turn on remote writes the real config.toml.

items.title: When the operator clicks Turn on remote, the dialog POSTs /api/machines/fly/enable-remote and refetches /api/machines

Given the enable route returns 409 with a message, the dialog renders that message in its role=alert element
Given POST /api/machines/fly returns 409 remote-disabled, the dialog renders the Turn on remote button
Refuse pan admin config set remote.enabled

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-4905.md WI-10. In src/cli/commands/config-set.ts configSetCommand, after the key-pattern check, refuse key remote.enabled with exit 1 and the stderr text from the PRD; add a header comment line and a test in tests/unit/cli/config-set.test.ts.
